rooms.name: Hawes Group Study Room 206
rooms.text: This room has table seating for six with a whiteboard and is reservable for collaborative study; when empty, it is also available for walk-in use.

rooms.name: Leicht Group Study Room 205
rooms.text: This room has table seating for six with a whiteboard and is reservable for collaborative study; when empty, it is also available for walk-in use.

rooms.name: Newman Exploration Center Study Room A08
rooms.text: Also called the Expedition Office, this room has table seating for four and is reservable for collaborative study. When empty, it is available for walk-in use.

rooms.name: Reber Group Study Room 207
rooms.text: This room is reservable for collaborative study; when empty, it is also available for walk-in use. Table seating for six with a whiteboard.

rooms.name: Research Studio Room A06
rooms.text: This room has collaborative workstations that provide students with access to specialized software. On-site use and appointment-based remote access are available.

rooms.name: Study Pod 1
rooms.text: The standing booth is for individuals to engage in shorter phone calls, virtual meetings, or study activities. When empty, it is available for walk-in use.

rooms.name: Study Pod 2
rooms.text: This double booth is reservable for two individuals to engage in group work or study. When empty, it is available for walk-in use.

rooms.name: Study Pod 3
rooms.text: This studio booth is reservable for individuals to engage in phone calls, virtual meetings, or study activities. When empty, it is available for walk-in use.

rooms.name: Tuteur Group Study Room 208
rooms.text: This room has table seating for ten and is reservable for collaborative study; when empty, it is also available for walk-in use.

rooms.name: Virginia Dowsing Toliver Group Study Room 204
rooms.text: This room has table seating for six and is reservable for collaborative study; when empty, it is also available for walk-in use.

rooms.name: Faculty Study Room 218
rooms.text: This room has four study carrels and is available on a first-come, first-served basis via a WashU ID faculty card swipe.

rooms.name: Ginkgo Room
rooms.text: This is an open seating space for sixteen that features exhibitions, lounge seating, and small work tables.

rooms.name: Graduate Study Room 213
rooms.text: This room has six study carrels available on a first-come, first-served basis to graduate students with a valid WashU ID.

rooms.name: Graduate Study Room 214
rooms.text: This room has eight study carrels available on a first-come, first-served basis and is accessible to graduate students with a valid WashU ID.

rooms.name: Graduate Study Room 326
rooms.text: This room has study carrels and armchairs available on a first-come, first-served basis and is accessible to graduate students with a valid WashU ID.

rooms.name: Graduate Study Room A30
rooms.text: This room has twelve study carrels and some armchairs available on a first-come, first-served basis to graduate students with a valid WashU ID. This room does not allow eating. This room is designated for silent study, with no keyboard/laptop use and no talking.

rooms.name: Graduate Study Room B25
rooms.text: This room has eight study carrels with some armchairs available on a first-come, first-served basis to graduate students with a valid WashU ID.

rooms.name: Group Study Room 217
rooms.text: This room has four small tables with armless chairs and cushioned benches available on a first-come, first-served basis.

rooms.name: Harris Reading Room 211
rooms.text: This room has two round tables with chairs, a coffee table, and nine armchairs available on a first-come, first-served basis.

rooms.name: Instruction Room 1
rooms.text: When not in use by the Libraries, this room is available on a first-come, first-served basis for studying during all library open hours.

rooms.name: Instruction Room 3
rooms.text: This instruction room has eight tables/38 seats and whiteboards. When not in use by the Libraries, this room is available on a first-come, first-served basis for studying during all library open hours.

rooms.name: Northwest Corner Study Carrels
rooms.text: This space has study carrels available on a first-come, first-served basis.

rooms.name: Quiet Study Room 210
rooms.text: This room is available on a first-come, first-served basis for quiet study at eight carrels.

rooms.name: Quiet Study Room 212
rooms.text: This room is available on a first-come, first-served basis for quiet study at carrels.

rooms.name: Quiet Study Room 323
rooms.text: This room is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Twelve study carrels are available.

rooms.name: Quiet Study Room B24
rooms.text: This room is available on a first-come, first-served basis for quiet study at fourteen carrels.

rooms.name: Roffer Lerner Study Room 215
rooms.text: This room is available on a first-come, first-served basis for study at three small tables with armchairs.

rooms.name: Short-term Carrels
rooms.text: Graduate students needing space for research and writing may use individual, short-term (day-use or 3-hour) carrels by checking out a key at the Help Desk. Carrels are available on a first-come, first-served basis.

rooms.name: The Sky Room 332
rooms.text: This room has table seating for ten plus fourteen lounge chairs around the perimeter of the room.

rooms.name: East Asian Library Group Study Room
rooms.text: This room has table seating for eight and is reservable for collaborative study; when empty, it is also available for walk-in use.

rooms.name: Kopolow Business Library Group Study Rooms
rooms.text: Seven group study rooms, each with six chairs, one table, access to power outlets, and a whiteboard, are available for reservation or for walk-in use when empty.

rooms.name: Bloomberg Lab
rooms.text: There are eight terminals available on a first-come, first-served basis for group study use when not in use for official instruction sessions. No drinks or food are allowed in the lab.

rooms.name: Rome Seminar Room
rooms.text: Reservable for study or Library instruction. Please check in at the Help Desk. Maximum seating for twelve; A/V equipment includes a PC, screen, projector, and sound system.

rooms.name: Kranzberg Art & Architecture Library Graduate Study Room
rooms.text: This room is only accessible to graduate students in the Sam Fox School and the Department of Art History & Archaeology on a first-come, first-served basis. Please check in at the Help Desk for the door code.
